config.rrf_ties: exact rational score then chunk_id ascending
config.union_order: round robin dense first; skip repeated chunk_id

full_union_diagnostic.scope: Unranked union coverage only; not an equal-Top10 quality comparison

latency.scope: Reused channel measurements and new fusion processing measured separately; no synthetic end-to-end sum

definitions.MRR@10: Mean reciprocal rank of first labelled support, zero beyond rank 10.
definitions.Recall@K: Fraction of answerable questions with at least one labelled supporting chunk in top K, per original technical design.
definitions.all_gold_coverage@5: Separate mean fraction of labelled support IDs retrieved, not the plan Recall@5.

quality.nDCG_reason: No graded relevance labels; not reported.
